scope: One 600-second normal-settings run of the unchanged nextest, clippy and nextest-config Nix checks, tracing only the directly launched client main thread
conditional_next_stage: Run the required repository flake gate with a 3500-second deadline only if the traced three-check run exits 0 without timeout
trace_privilege: Unprivileged strace launching a new owned Nix client; no attach and no following of children or other threads
trace_payload_policy: Raw pointer-form read/receive arguments; no read or receive payload bytes retained by strace
constraints: No shared or unrelated process signals
Deadline termination limited to the new owned command process group
No host setting change, daemon restart or manual shared-data deletion
No source, dependency or toolchain pin change
No acceptance weakening or premature lifecycle closure
